QuestInfo.name: The Ring's Secret
QuestInfo.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
QuestInfo.0: Ask Sergeant Bravo about the ring again.
QuestInfo.1: Sergeant Bravo seems to know something about the ring. He promised to fess up and give back the ring if you bring him 100 Hector Tails to cover the rising cost of wolf skins.
QuestInfo.2: Sergeant Bravo clearly knows this ring. After you gave him the Hector Tails, Sergeant Bravo gave the ring back to you and promised to tell you everything he knows about the ring.

0.0: Oh, this ring is truly beautiful... I mean, it's old and worn and looks terrible, but it holds a special power. Let me take a closer look at it... Hmm, fine, very fine. You know, I can tell you quite a bit about this ring if you can help me out. Are you up for it?

yes.0: Great, we have a deal! The wolves are a lot tougher nowadays. You bring me #b100 #t4000051##k items, I'll give you the ring and tell you whatever you want. But hustle up, I ain't got all day.

no.0: Don't you want to know this ring's secret? It's a pretty great secret.

0.1: Alright, you want my help, you gotta help me. Wolf skin prices are through the roof and they're a lot tougher nowadays. You bring me #b50 #t4000051# items and 50 #t4000052# items#k, I'll give you the ring and tell you whatever you want. But speed it up, I ain't got all day.

1.0: You've brought #b100 #t4000051##k items! Marvelous. I will give you the ring back and tell you everything I know, as I promised.

item.0: I need some wolf skins, but they're a lot tougher to get nowadays. You bring me #b50 #t4000051# items and 50 #t4000052# items#k, I'll give you the ring and tell you whatever you want.
